entities.name: Gorev Hadszak
entities.description: A grizzled retired Boros Wojek who attends a play about the end of the Guildpact and warns his nephew about the Dimir.

entities.name: Pel Javya
entities.description: Gorev's nephew, a newly minted Wojek patrolling the Tenth District.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Hero of the play, an investigator who faced Szadek.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Former guildmaster of the Dimir, a vampire who helped destroy the Guildpact.

entities.name: Augustin
entities.description: Azorius figure who, with Szadek, destroyed the law.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: Angelic leader of the Boros whose death is told in legends.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Ravnican guild of Wojeks, swiftblades and skyknights that upholds the law.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: Ravnican guild that works unseen from the Undercity.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Magical contract between the ten guilds of Ravnica that held for over 10,000 years before it ended.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: District of Ravnica where Pel walks his beat.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: Home of Razia and the angels of the Boros.

entities.name: Prahv
entities.description: Place whose destruction is told in legends.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: Underground of Ravnica where the Dimir hide.

events.summary: Gorev and Pel watch a play on the anniversary of the end of the Guildpact.
events.quote: It was the anniversary of the end of the Guildpact

events.summary: Gorev remembers the old Boros under Razia and the angels of Sunhome.
events.quote: Gorev was one of them, beholding his angelic commander, bathing in her fierce, sublime gaze.

events.summary: Gorev tells Pel the Boros stood for 10,000 years of order on Ravnica.
events.quote: They stood for 10,000 years of order on Ravnica.

events.summary: Gorev warns Pel to watch the Dimir and study off-the-books magic.
events.quote: That's where the deeper layers of the Dimir are—off the books.

events.summary: Gorev tells Pel that Szadek and Augustin destroyed the law and that the play is a tragedy.
events.quote: It is the destruction of the greatest creation ever put on paper.

events.summary: Pel resolves to get reassigned to strike at the Dimir in the Undercity.
events.quote: He knew he had to get reassigned from topside duty

relations.quote: Next to Gorev sat his nephew, Pel Javya
That's why I joined the Wojeks.
a newly minted Wojek fresh from the academy
Szadek, the former guildmaster of the Dimir.

relations.note: Gorev sees the Dimir as constant troublemakers.
relations.quote: they are always going to be causing trouble.
